rules: Do not combine original HTML 28 groups with the 19 third-party analysis tags without an explicit row-level mapping.
Source text and original conditions take priority over derived flags.
Major-code mentions and catalog references are not applicant eligibility.
Never merge the same code across education levels; the enrollment code books keep one namespace per edition.
A code ending in 00 is the enrollment form of its four-digit parent, not a new major.
Names listed inside 不含/除 exclusion brackets are exclusions, never coverage.
Z, J and S codes are institution-local; the 2026 roster publishes names only, so no code-to-name link may be inferred.
A missing job cutoff is not zero; retain year, batch and score basis.
Sources and SHA-256 attest only the verification scopes actually recorded.
An official national workbook match does not cover later amendments or agency-specific major catalogs that were never published.
A requirement written as X门类 may resolve to the X discipline-gate node, citing the MOE 2027 statement; no other suffix normalization is allowed.
A source-declared two-digit gate code in parentheses may resolve to that gate node.
Agency category phrases with no published membership list stay unresolved; a 2026 institution-recruitment catalog is not applicable to 2027 civil service positions.
Review status is a work state: a catalog candidate is not a cleared position, and the 5,835 review denominator is not an uncovered count.
The MOE 门类 rule is cited from a statement scoped to MOE positions; applying it to other agencies is an inference and is flagged as such.
Conflict metrics are distinct: positions (59), structured conflict entries (101) and content_conflict entries (67) must not be interchanged.
A gate_scope_rule hit on a non-MOE position is provisional and must not enter the conservative coverage numerator.
A source-declared two-digit gate code printed in the position text is direct evidence and counts as exact.
Conflict families are separate: semantic_conflict indicates a possible source inconsistency; multi_namespace_diagnostic does not.
A 备注 code is resolved in the level named by an explicit bounded label; outside such a label the position education is used and the fallback is marked.
A mixed label such as 本科或研究生阶段 falls back to the position education and is flagged, never widened to both levels.
